stem: Which sentence does the author include to suggest that the girls on the new soccer team most likely appreciated the support they received?

options.label: F
options.text: When the bright orange uniforms arrived, the Nordkamp girls danced with delight. (paragraph 4)

options.label: G
options.text: With their new name—the Pumpkins—and uniforms, the experienced team was ready to enter tournament play. (paragraph 7)

options.label: H
options.text: On December 1, 2006, the Pumpkins gathered and marched in a big orange line to a field near the Nordkamp Center. (paragraph 9)

options.label: J
options.text: Sitting on the grass and eating peanut-butter sandwiches, the Pumpkins waited impatiently for the team to show up. (paragraph 12)
